name: Overdraft Facility Review and Renewal

dependency_notes.JRN-001: Customer (ENT-001) and Account (ENT-004) must exist with an active authorised overdraft facility. Overdraft facility terms (limit, APR, expiry_date) stored on Account entity.

business_context: A personal customer's authorised overdraft facility reaches its annual review date. The bank's automated credit risk system reassesses affordability and creditworthiness using refreshed credit bureau data and account behavioural analysis. The review determines whether to renew at existing terms, modify the limit/APR, or withdraw the facility. FCA CONC 6.7 persistent debt rules require the bank to identify customers paying more in interest and charges than principal over 18 months and take remedial action. FCA PS19/16 mandates a single APR for overdraft pricing. Consumer Duty (PS22/9) requires fair value outcome evidence for all overdraft products.

phases.name: Automated Review Trigger
phases.description: The batch scheduling system identifies accounts with overdraft facilities expiring within 30 days. For each qualifying account, it publishes an OverdraftReviewTriggered event. This runs as a nightly batch process scanning Account.overdraft_expiry_date against current date + 30 days.
entry_conditions: No pending overdraft review already in progress for this account
exit_conditions: OverdraftReview (ENT-054) record created with status = initiated

phases.name: Credit Bureau Refresh and Behavioural Analysis
phases.description: SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) consumes the OverdraftReviewTriggered event and initiates a credit bureau data refresh from Experian/Equifax/TransUnion. Simultaneously analyses 12-month account behaviour: average balance, overdraft utilisation frequency, missed payment count, income pattern stability. Produces an affordability assessment score and updated credit risk grade.
entry_conditions: Customer.credit_bureau_consent = true (obtained at account opening JRN-001)
exit_conditions: Affordability score and credit grade calculated

phases.name: Persistent Debt Screening
phases.description: SVC-001 checks whether the customer meets the FCA CONC 6.7 persistent debt criteria: customer has paid more in interest/charges than in principal repayment over the trailing 18 months. If persistent debt is detected, the review outcome must include an intervention pathway (reduced limit, repayment plan, or facility suspension). At 36 months of persistent debt, the facility must be suspended.

phases.name: Review Decision and Terms Update
phases.description: SVC-001 consolidates the credit assessment, behavioural analysis, and persistent debt screening to reach a review decision: renew (same terms), modify (adjust limit or APR), or withdraw (facility removal with 30-day notice). Updated terms are applied to Account.overdraft_limit, Account.overdraft_apr, Account.overdraft_expiry_date. Consumer Duty fair value evidence is recorded.
entry_conditions: Credit assessment score and grade available from EVT-115
exit_conditions: If renew or modify: updated terms applied to Account (ENT-004)
If withdraw: 30-day withdrawal notice period begins

phases.name: Customer Notification
phases.description: PER-001 is notified of the overdraft review outcome via push notification, in-app message, and email. For renewals: confirmation of continued facility and terms. For modifications: clear explanation of changes, new terms, and effective date. For withdrawals: 30-day notice with explanation, guidance on managing without overdraft, and signposting to debt advice services (FCA requirement). Persistent debt customers receive the CONC 6.7 intervention letter.
exit_conditions: If persistent debt: CONC 6.7 intervention letter sent
If withdrawal: 30-day notice letter sent with debt advice signposting
Audit record written to WORM pipeline

happy_path.description: Overdraft review triggered 30 days before expiry. Credit bureau refresh returns satisfactory score. Behavioural analysis confirms stable income and low overdraft utilisation. No persistent debt. Facility renewed at same limit and APR. Customer notified. No action required from customer.

alternative_paths.name: Modified Terms — Reduced Limit
alternative_paths.description: Credit assessment or behavioural analysis indicates increased risk (missed payments, reduced income). Facility renewed but limit reduced and/or APR adjusted. Customer notified of changed terms with 30-day advance notice.

alternative_paths.name: Persistent Debt — 18-Month Intervention
alternative_paths.description: Persistent debt screening identifies customer paying more in interest/charges than principal over 18 months. Facility renewed but with intervention: reduced limit, repayment plan offered, and CONC 6.7 intervention communication sent. Customer advised of options including debt advice.

exception_paths.name: Facility Withdrawal — Adverse Credit
exception_paths.description: Credit bureau refresh reveals significant adverse data (CCJ, IVA, bankruptcy, or severely deteriorated score). Facility withdrawn with 30-day notice. Customer notified with explanation, debt advice signposting, and details of how to manage without the overdraft.

exception_paths.name: Persistent Debt — 36-Month Facility Suspension
exception_paths.description: Customer has been in persistent debt for 36 months with no resolution despite 18-month intervention. FCA CONC 6.7 mandates facility suspension. Overdraft facility suspended with immediate effect. Customer notified and signposted to free debt advice services (StepChange, Citizens Advice, National Debtline).

exception_paths.name: Credit Bureau Unavailable
exception_paths.description: Credit bureau API returns an error or timeout during PH-084. SVC-012 retries once after 30 seconds. If still unavailable: review is deferred by 7 days. OverdraftReview status set to deferred. No customer notification at this stage. Automated retry scheduled.

design_decisions.decision: Overdraft review is a fully automated batch process. No human approval is required for renewals at existing or reduced terms.
design_decisions.rationale: FCA CONC 5A.3 requires affordability assessment but does not mandate human review for renewals. Automated credit decisioning at renewal reduces operational cost and ensures all reviews are completed before facility expiry. Manual intervention is reserved for persistent debt cases requiring customer contact.
alternatives_considered: Manual approval by credit analyst for all reviews
design_decisions.rejected_because: Manual review does not scale — a mid-tier bank with 500,000+ overdraft accounts cannot manually review each annual renewal. Automated decisioning with rule-based guardrails is industry standard (Experian PowerCurve, FICO).

design_decisions.decision: Persistent debt screening is performed by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core), not SVC-012 (Risk Engine).
design_decisions.rationale: Persistent debt is a transaction history calculation (interest paid vs principal repaid over 18 months) that requires access to the account transaction ledger. SVC-001 owns Account (ENT-004) and the transaction history. SVC-012 provides the credit risk assessment but does not hold transaction data. Persistent debt screening is a regulatory obligation on the account owner, not a credit risk model.

design_decisions.decision: OverdraftReview (ENT-054) is a new entity owned by SVC-001, separate from the Account entity.
design_decisions.rationale: Each annual review is a discrete event with its own lifecycle (initiated -> assessed -> decided -> notified -> closed). Storing review history as a separate entity enables audit trail tracking per review cycle and supports FCA Consumer Duty outcome evidence per review period. The review references Account (ENT-004) but is not part of the Account aggregate.
